integrations.title: Connections
integrations.adbMissingHint: adb runs on the service workstation, not on the phone; the gateway forwards the device list.
integrations.noAdb: adb not available on this host
integrations.preflightNote: The check reads battery level, bootloader state, patch age and checksums. Unlocking, flashing, FRP bypass and IMEI changes are deliberately not implemented – they belong in OEM tools with proof of ownership.
integrations.vendorNote: Core table from the Android docs; for the full list start the gateway with --usb-ids /usr/share/hwdata/usb.ids – the host table then wins.

portview.title: Port view – find the server automatically
portview.subtitle: Host & port via native bridge (UDP) or HTTP probe
portview.emptyHint: Nothing searched yet. Locally:  python3 mobile-server/mobile_ble_server.py --mock   and  npm run mcp:bridge – then press “Automatic”.
portview.noBase: No address set yet – scan or enter one manually.
portview.manualSaved: manually set – the app now uses these addresses
portview.reset: back to relative (dev proxy / same origin)
portview.manualNote: Note: http addresses always work in the native app (CapacitorHttp); in a browser only when the page itself is http – otherwise mixed content is blocked.
portview.noStatus: Gateway status unreachable right now – commands then go through the bridge or dev proxy.

grabber.title: Grabber – import beats, samples, styles, effects, filters
grabber.subtitle: URL import into the local catalogue (available offline)
grabber.needUrl: Please add at least one URL.
grabber.viaGateway: Import runs on the mobile server (64 MiB, internal file servers allowed, SHA-256 dedupe).
grabber.viaBrowser: No gateway found: browser import (CORS limits, max 32 MiB). Run PortView or start the mobile server.
grabber.empty: Nothing imported yet. Add a URL above – or a pack manifest (.json with “dingelschwing_pack”).
grabber.demoHint: Fills the field with the demo pack from public/demo/packs/
grabber.pageHint: The agent pulls the page through the mobile server (SSRF filter, catalogue), reviews the content and files everything internally: the page as an asset, linked beats/samples/styles/effects/filters, and a library entry for RAG search. In the chat window simply drop the URL (or a file).
grabber.needPageUrl: Please enter the http(s) URL of a page.
grabber.libraryHint: Review the content and file it as a knowledge document (scripts removed, secrets masked)
